description: 국토교통부_한국건설기술연구원 상시/수시 교통량 정보조회서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 상시와 수시 교통량 정보조회서비스는 연도별, 도로 종류별, 차종별, 시간대별 등의 조건을 기반으로 고속도로와 일반국도 등 다양한 도로유형별 차량 통행량을 일자별로 조회할 수 있으며,. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 도로 종류, 교통 데이터, 상시 교통량, 수시 교통량, 도로유형별. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
